name: @cratylus/invoke
//: The INSTALLABLE UNIT — the one package a consumer installs globally. It DECLARES its capability packages as real dependencies, so `npm i -g` resolves them under an isolated store. runtime stays the contract leaf and must NOT depend on a capability (that would cycle: every capability depends on the runtime).
description: The run-time entry: composes the runtime with its declared capability plugins and ships them as an installable command.
author: Lance Caraccioli <lance.caraccioli@gmail.com>
